commit_message: Avoid Nsight dependency in WSL CUDA setup
pr_title: GameEngine: avoid Nsight dependency in WSL CUDA setup
pr_body:
## Summary

Fixes the ADR0155 WSL2 CUDA bootstrap on Ubuntu 24.04. The previous `cuda-toolkit-12-4` meta-package pulled Nsight Systems 2023.4.4, whose `libtinfo5` dependency is unavailable on Noble.

The managed setup now installs only the CUDA 12.4 compiler and development-library meta-packages needed to build llama.cpp (`cuda-compiler-12-4` and `cuda-libraries-dev-12-4`). Provenance records both exact package versions and unit coverage rejects regression to the full toolkit meta-package.

The WSL driver boundary remains unchanged: no Linux NVIDIA driver is installed, and GameEngine still verifies `/dev/dxg`, pinned llama.cpp revision, CUDA device visibility, and built binary SHA-256 values.

## Validation

Run affected Windows Validation for `engine-editor`. Hardware WSL2 validation should then be repeated on the representative machine that reproduced the `nsight-systems-2023.4.4 -> libtinfo5` failure.

Visual Validation is not required because no Editor layout or rendering changes are involved.
